coordinates.x: axial distance along the unrolled trunk

index_note: Each state index is the raw maximum Tsai-Hill integration-point value for its source element, repeated for each intersecting wood triangle. The viewer may clamp color at 1; values are not capped here.
grain_note: Fiber axes and outlines are clipped to the shared window. Grain lines use plot_trunk2d.grain and keep every third point plus each clipped endpoint. Triangles are retained when their source triangle intersects the window; clip them in the viewer.
comparison_note: The hole has D = 60 mm and loaded branch D = 100 mm; geometry and load differ. The branch weight is a prescribed 1 kN load, not measured mass.

trunk_hole.note: Woodpecker hole, D = 60 mm. The hole is smaller than the branch inclusions, so this is not a diameter-matched comparison.

trunk_branch_weight.note: Same D = 100 mm branch inclusion as trunk_branch, with the source model's downward 1 kN equivalent body-force resultant; this is a prescribed load, not a measured branch mass.
